Upstream SHA-256:

firebase-auth.js: 72decbdf62edb7d86249db701206bf08a6ef694ac1a96105b9aac7c3cecb0d0d

Local modifications:
- firebase-auth.js imports ./firebase-app.js instead of the CDN URL.
- Removed sourceMappingURL comments because source maps are not distributed.
- Normalized one trailing space and final blank lines for repository checks.

Keep both files in this versioned directory when deploying. Both application
and auth must import the same app module URL. Actual sign-in still requires
network access to Google and the configured Firebase auth domain.
